video_title: Inside AJ Dybantsa’s Trip To Jamaica

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his approach to basketball and avoiding burnout
quotes.excerpt: I don't get starstruck. I played in front of plenty of people.
quotes.quote: I don't get starstruck. I played in front of plenty of people. Katy Perry came to my game in ninth grade. LeBron James came to my ninth grade game. I've seen them courtside, I had 25. The only person I'll ever get starstruck of is Michael Jackson and Michael Jordan. If I met Michael Jordan, I'd be like, I'm starstruck.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on giving back to the community and staying the course
quotes.excerpt: You don't have to be on the biggest and best basketball court to be a better basketball player.
quotes.quote: That's why people like me and other people are coming back to try to give back, give some better gear, try to raise money to build better facilities. But just stay the course. You don't have to be on the biggest and best basketball court to be a better basketball player. So stay the course and you'll get noticed.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his motivation for community service
quotes.excerpt: I kind of just seen that at a young age, so when I was able to do it.
quotes.quote: It kind of instilled in me and my sisters when we were young. I think I was six when I went back to my dad's home in the Congo and he gave back pens and pencils to his school. I kind of just seen that at a young age, so when I was able to do it, I was able to get back.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his relationship with coach Patrick Ewing
quotes.excerpt: He's my coach now. He's kind of just saying let's go win some games this year.
quotes.quote: He's my coach now. He's kind of just saying let's go win some games this year.
